title: Evidence Replay: inspect before you act
audience: Developers inheriting a claim who need freshness and omissions visible before rerunning anything.
promise: Open a receipt without executing it, classify its target freshness, preview the exact rerun contract, and preserve the producer trail.
story: A Debug Trail receipt opens with its claim, historical outcome, target, and omissions visible.
The current repository revision makes the old receipt stale instead of silently upgrading it.
The rerun preview names the command, mutation class, interface, and human authorization requirement.
Malformed, unsupported, and partially bound receipts fail closed in the same local contract.
verified_locally: Supported Debug Trail receipt inspection without execution.
Stale target classification and blocked rerun preview on the current checkout.
Current dev tests, lint, and package checks pass at revision 780094c.
Malformed, unsupported, partial-target, and unknown-applicability negative cases in the test suite.
open_gates: Run the complete Debug Trail/Rule Lab current-stale-unknown-cancelled matrix.
Bind producer identity, target identity, and omissions through a current shared envelope receipt.
Capture direct human-facing viewer acceptance and a crop-safe image preview.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and record external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves the local W2 inspect-only reader slice; it does not claim hosted UI, complete producer coverage, execution, or publication.
